_capture: osqueryi 5.12.1 (osqueryd -S --json), linux x86_64, in the container debian:trixie, 2026-11-26; the packages, users and files are those of that image

deb_packages.sql: SELECT name, version, arch FROM deb_packages WHERE name IN ('bash', 'coreutils', 'nonexistent-pkg');

users.sql: SELECT username, uid, gid, shell, directory FROM users WHERE username IN ('root');

groups.sql: SELECT groupname, gid FROM groups WHERE groupname IN ('root');

file.sql: SELECT path, type, mode, uid, gid FROM file WHERE path IN ('/etc/passwd', '/etc');
